description: Controls the active FORGE Governance Synchronizer operating mode.
rules: Locked mode permits repository inspection and validation but prohibits governance document writes.
Shadow mode permits updates only to experimental synchronized governance documents.
Hybrid mode permits shadow updates and explicitly delegated authoritative section updates.
Authoritative mode permits all explicitly delegated authoritative section updates while preserving immutable and protected content.
Changing the operating mode does not expand the maximum capabilities granted by governance policy.
All modes remain subject to repository evidence, validation, protected-content preservation, and transactional rollback.
